crossRefs.note: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
On the eighth day Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, prince of the children of Manasseh,

people.name: Gamaliel
people.line: Leader of the tribe of Manasseh during the Exodus.

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Pedahzur
people.line: Father of Gamaliel, leader from Manasseh

translations.web: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.
translations.bsb: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was over the division of the tribe of Manasseh,
translations.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
translations.asv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
